claims: President Donald Trump fired Pam Bondi as U.S. Attorney General on April 2, 2026.
Pam Bondi had a 14-month tenure as U.S. Attorney General.
Pam Bondi served as Attorney General from February 4, 2025, until April 2, 2026.
Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche is replacing Pam Bondi on an acting basis.

Trump reportedly grew frustrated with Pam Bondi's handling of the Justice Department, particularly regarding the Epstein investigation and lack of prosecutions against his political rivals, such as James B. Comey.
Pam Bondi's firing came shortly before she was scheduled to testify before the House Oversight Committee regarding her handling of the Epstein case.
Pam Bondi was the second cabinet official to be fired within a month.
